text: This Terminal imitates two tools. A scanner lists what machines run and their likely weaknesses; a console is where testers look weaknesses up. Every name is invented. Zainab's token is a sign-in with no password, and it stops working six minutes from now.
style: Security lead on Merrin & Sallow's outsourced IT provider (Fenlow Managed IT), in her 40s, warm and practical. Speak with a consistent London and southern English accent throughout — do not shift to any other accent.
